connections.description: University of Michigan invested $105M in Hydrazine Capital II and $75M in Hydrazine Capital IV — two of the endowment's largest VC fund checks ever. University of Michigan is the sole outside LP in Fund IV.

University of Michigan Endowment committed $75M as sole outside LP in Hydrazine Capital IV and $105M as major LP in Hydrazine Capital II ($180M total). This is the only major documented outside institutional LP in the Altman fund complex. No prior Altman-Michigan connection is documented to explain the relationship origin.

University of Michigan endowment is confirmed LP in Hydrazine Capital IV ($75M, sole outside investor) and Hydrazine Capital II ($105M, major LP). Total disclosed Hydrazine commitment: $180M. Decision-maker: Dan Feder, Sr MD Investments.
